column1: # Topic overrides — the hand-written half of the tagging, and the last word.
#   word<TAB>tag,tag        assign exactly these topics
#   word<TAB>               assign none (cancels a wrong assignment)
# Precedence: this file, then tags-llm.tsv (the pass over the whole deck),
# then the keyword rules in lib/tagging.js. An entry here wins over both,
# including the empty one — that is how a wrong topic gets removed without
# arguing with whatever produced it.
# Valid topics: see FIELDS and SITUATIONS in lib/tagging.js.
# It held 25 entries. Every one has been retired, and the reason is worth
# keeping, because it is one mistake in three shapes.
#  - 14 were cancellations. 勇気 "courage, nerve" and 武器 "weapon, arms"
#    matched the `health` rule on "nerve" and "arms"; 歩く "to go on foot" on
#    "foot". They existed to blank a wrong tag, and blanking was all they could
#    do, because the nine-topic list had nothing right to offer instead. The
#    pass now gives those three feelings, home and movement — so the
#    cancellations had turned into deletions of correct answers, which is
#    exactly how they surfaced on the first run after the pass landed: fourteen
#    cards with no topic at all, every one of them from this file.
#  - 5 were additions the pass covers better. An override replaces rather than
#    merges, so 袋 `konbini` was losing the `home` the pass gives it, and
#    焼く `food` was losing `actions`.
#  - 6 named words the deck does not contain: 値段, 茹でる, 炊く, 宿題, 試験,
#    黒板, 離婚. They were written from an idea of what a beginner deck holds
#    rather than from the deck, and never applied to anything.
# The mechanism stays. It is the right place for a judgement that should not
# have to be re-derived, and a wrong topic on the phone is one line here.
